newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Verbund Q1 pretax profit down 9.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Verbund Q1 pretax profit down 9.5 pct.

text.p: Austrian national grid company Verbund said on Tuesday pretax profit in the first quarter of the year fell to 581 million schillings from 642.3 million in the year-ago period.
"The reason for this decline are primarily lower sales, which were compensated for by the positive effects of the ongoing restructuring programme," the group said in a statement.

First-quarter sales fell 5.5 percent to 5.780 billion schillings as the company's electricity sales to Austria's regional utilities dropped because of the relatively mild winter temperatures, Verbund said.
